output.title: Callback scheduling hours for member callbacks
output.draft_text:
Q: What hours can we schedule a callback?

A: Schedule member callbacks on weekdays between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern (source: approved unit U-KNOWN-FACT).

Additional details to confirm:
- Holidays: On company holidays, callbacks [can / cannot] be scheduled. Observed holidays are [list of observed holidays or link to holiday calendar].
- Weekends: If a member asks for a weekend callback, [instruction for weekend requests, e.g., offer the next available weekday slot].
- Members in other time zones: Convert the member's preferred time to Eastern before scheduling. [Any additional guidance on time zone handling].
- Requests outside the window: If a member asks for a callback outside 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern, [approved alternative or escalation path].
- How to schedule: Book the callback in [system or tool name] by [steps to schedule a callback].
